subject: Workplace Skills
title: Networking Across Levels
description: A short lesson to help you apply Networking Across Levels.

hook.text: A junior analyst sent a thank-you note to the CEO after a town hall. The CEO remembered her name a year later.

buildup.text: People only network laterally or upward. Networking down — with junior peers — is equally valuable for insight.

discovery.text: Senior people appreciate genuine curiosity. Junior people offer fresh perspectives. Cross-level networks win.

twist.text: Don't ask senior people for favors on first contact. Ask for five minutes of their perspective. It's a smaller ask.

climax.text: Build cross-level relationships by offering value at every level: upward bring insight, laterally share resources.

punchline.text: Network up, down, and across. Every level has value.

quiz.question: How should you approach networking with senior leaders?
options: Ask for career advice or a job referral immediately
Ask for five minutes of their perspective rather than a big favor
Wait until you're at a similar level to connect
